core_idea: Cinq Assoc. South Section 4 Director Sinclair is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist / Support — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. Support passive (**Too Slow**) applies at **Combat Start** — set deployment with the intended ally before turn one.
playstyle_guide:
- **Too Slow** fires at **Combat Start** — confirm roster and slot order pre-fight so the right ally receives the buff.
- Build enough **Poise Count** for your scaling passives before **Contre Attaque** — **S2 — Engagement** adds **+2 Poise Count** on **Clash Win** and **+1 Poise Count** per **On Hit** coin; **S1 — Remise** adds **+2 Poise Count** at **On Use**.
- **Haste** raises Speed for next turn — several bonuses here require being faster than the target.
- Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn; coordinate team burst on the next turn.

**S1 — Remise** (BP 3, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's by 2 or more, Coin Power +1 ; [On Use] Gain +2 Poise Count
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's by 2 or more, Coin Power +1; [On Use] Gain +2 Poise Count

**S2 — Engagement** (BP 4, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, Coin Power +1 for every 2 Speed difference (Max 2) ; [Clash Win] Gain +2 Poise Count
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, Coin Power +1 for every 2 Speed difference (Max 2); [Clash Win] Gain +2 Poise Count

**S3 — Contre Attaque** (BP 5, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / Slightly High stacked).
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, Coin Power +1 for every 2 Speed difference (Max 3) ; [Clash Win] Consume 10 Poise Count. Gain Poise equal to Poise Count consumed. Against targets with Declared Duel — Sinclair, gain Poise equal to (Poise Count consumed x 2) instead ; [Clash Win] If this unit conducted a Single Combat with the target Slot's Attack Skill, inflict 1 Fragile On Hit (Twice per turn)
- +30% Damage on Critical Hit

Combat passive — **Slumbering Bloodthirst**: Turn End: Gain +2 Max Speed next turn for every 5 Poise Count (Max 6).
  - Combat Start: If Speed of all allies is higher than Speed of all enemies, gain 1 Pierce DMG Up.
